correctness.rationale: For each forced path forest of j<=4 edges, exact completion count is 2^(b-1)(n-j-1)!; all non-path-forest contributions are zero. Character expansion reduces every Walsh multiplier to a 17-row exhaustive signature table, checked using all <=4-edge subgraphs of K8, and exact substitution at n=6..17 yields only two prescribed zero signature classes. For n>=18, W_n(S)>=M_n(1-4|S|/(n-1))>0. Direct enumeration of all Hamiltonian tours at n9 and n10 independently confirms both exceptional motifs, controls and exact signs. Combinatorial counts and Fourier character diagonalization yield the stated ranks; no extrapolation or machine-only infinite claim is made.

value.rationale: An infinite family of finite Fourier convolution operators is classified at natural low-frequency degree four, detecting exactly two exceptional graph orders and explicit graph-shape-dependent nonrecoverability. Sparse edge-sign queries and arbitrary low-degree signal recovery are mathematically motivated by Hamilton-tour statistics. The exception shapes, exact multiplicities, and uniform absence of further low-degree zeros form an all-order structural result, not a parameter substitution or known-table recomputation.
